name: Terrain Equation Bench
author: Rubato Audio
description: Diagnostic Wave Terrain engine comparing live equations with the 4 KB sampled lookup. Not a musical model.

controls.label: Equation
controls.description: Selects one benchmark equation or the sampled-grid baseline.

controls.label: Path offset
controls.description: Matches Wave Terrain's horizontal scan offset.

controls.label: Y offset
controls.description: Matches Wave Terrain's vertical scan offset.

outputs.main: Selected live equation scanned along the Wave Terrain path
outputs.aux: Alternate Sine(y + z) projection, unless the CPU probe tone is enabled
